title: Two assumed adaptation rates
hook: Two stated cases: explore the persistence parameter in a toy experience model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the persistence parameter in a toy experience model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Level, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the persistence parameter in a toy experience model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy level is baseline 5 plus shock 3 times exp(-Decay 0.1 × Time 10). What level results?
